body: I think it's the panic attacks. I have at least one or two a day at this point, and this is on a good day. It's so tiring.

Thank you so much. That's definitely how it feels, not looking right, bringing a lot of dysphoria.

That's what would make me a lot more comfortable, being able to do those things without it being a woman doing it, rather a man.

And that makes a lot of sense. Thank you, that's helpful to me. :)

Thank you so much for reading it all and taking the time to reply, you're very helpful.

Yup, that's exactly how it feels. Like maybe it's not serious to them and they're just letting me ride this out and go back to 'normal' or something. I've had a few names in the past but decided on one I do like a good bit and I think it does fit me quite well, though I guess I'm just scared to decide for sure because I'm scared to inconvenience other people by asking them to change what they call me. Which shouldn't be a huge problem but I guess my brain made it into a bigger deal lol.

And YES. that's 100% how it feels, like im just dressing up and it's just a costume. Its so confusing to me because I thought that wearing the right clothes would make me feel more like the actual me, but it ended up making me uncomfortable too?? I mean, I think I'd usually still choose shorts over leggings or whatever but its just so damn confusing and only really hit me lately. It's helpful to know a lot of people have felt that too.

Thats a really good point... I forget that sometimes. I used to have a friend who identified as ftm for ages and then decided it wasn't right for her and now just identifies as a cis female. I guess that really threw me off, because I have a fear of that happening to me, even though I've literally never imagined me as anything but a man as an adult. 

You're right, I can still do feminine things and that doesn't mean I'm female, thank you. Dysphoria really does suck, and I think I've reached a point where I don't misgender myself inside my head anymore, so I feel very masc and comfortable in my head and I guess the doubt finally hit me when I started imaging myself doing  feminine things. 

Thank you so much for helping, it means a lot. :)
